note: Version-3 issues at df2908090cda. No issue is new relative to version 2, so every label is carried over from the version-2 review of the same issue. Tuned on that review: not an independent precision estimate.

issues.label: a2
issues.reason: machine_shutdown calls smp_shutdown_nonboot_cpus with irqs off; confirmed in QEMU (riscv_kexec_shutdown_verify_20261102); kexec path only; arm64 and x86 do not disable irqs before it

issues.label: c
issues.reason: oops_enter takes the spinlock_t pause_on_oops_lock only when pause_on_oops is set; same in the common oops path of every architecture, not RISC-V specific

issues.label: c
issues.reason: zone spinlock_t in swsusp_save with irqs off is the common hibernation path of every architecture, not RISC-V specific

issues.label: b
issues.reason: flush_tlb_all takes the local path when fewer than two CPUs are online, as during create_image

issues.label: b
issues.reason: flush_icache_all returns after the local flush when fewer than two CPUs are online

issues.label: c
issues.reason: static inline on_thread_stack called from noinstr stackleak code while x86 uses __always_inline; impact not established

issues.label: c
issues.reason: static inline cpu_relax called from noinstr code while x86 uses __always_inline; impact not established

issues.label: c
issues.reason: noinstr arch_stack_walk calls instrumentable walk_stackframe; RISC-V has no objtool check

issues.label: c
issues.reason: noinstr do_page_fault calls handle_page_fault outside instrumentation_begin/end

issues.label: c
issues.reason: noinstr handle_riscv_irq calls irq_enter_rcu outside instrumentation_begin/end, which x86 wraps

issues.label: b
issues.reason: fevent_code comes from pmc->event_idx, validated and stored at configuration time; the guest cannot supply an out-of-range value here

issues.label: a
issues.reason: event_code = get_event_code(eidx) with eidx = cp->a3 from the guest SBI call; after the bound check it indexes kvpmu->fw_event[event_code] (store) without array_index_nospec; the upstream Spectre-v1 fix 2dda6a9e09ee protected ctr_idx in the same function but not event_code; x86 and arm64 KVM sanitise guest-provided PMU indices

issues.label: c
issues.reason: arm64 init_cache_level handles ACPI, RISC-V only the DT path; the common fetch_cache_info already sets the ACPI levels early, effect not checked
